auth.label: API Token
auth.description: StealthGPT API token sent with the api-token header. Activate API access, then copy the token from the API Key tab: https://www.stealthgpt.ai/api-dashboard/api-key.

actions.name: detect_ai_text
actions.description: Score how likely text is to be flagged as AI-generated with StealthGPT.

text.description: Text to analyze, up to 3,000 words.

inputSchema.description: Input for detecting AI-generated text with StealthGPT.

howLikelyToBeDetected.description: Score from 0 to 100 where a higher value means the text is more likely to be flagged as AI-generated.

wordsSpent.description: Words charged for this detection request.

remainingCredits.description: Prepaid word balance remaining after this request.

billingMode.description: Billing source used for this request.

meteredChargedCredits.description: Words added to metered usage, or zero when prepaid words were used.

outputSchema.description: AI detection score and billing details returned by StealthGPT.

actions.name: generate_text
actions.description: Generate text from instructions with StealthGPT and return usage details.

prompt.description: Instructions or topic for the content to generate.

model.description: StealthGPT model used to process the text.

tone.description: Writing complexity used when writingMode is essay.

qualityMode.description: Whether StealthGPT prioritizes rewrite quality or speed.

isMultilingual.description: Whether non-English input should produce output in the original language.

outputFormat.description: Format of the generated or humanized result.

inputSchema.description: Input for generating text with StealthGPT.

howLikelyToBeDetected.description: Historical StealthGPT score where a higher value means the content reads as more human.

remainingCredits.description: Prepaid word balance remaining after this request.

billingMode.description: Billing source used for this request.

meteredChargedCredits.description: Words added to metered usage, or zero when prepaid words were used.

outputSchema.description: Text processing result and billing details returned by StealthGPT.

actions.name: get_balance
actions.description: Get the current StealthGPT prepaid and pay-as-you-go word balance.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require input parameters.

credits.description: Prepaid words available in the account.

unbilledCredits.description: Words accumulated for metered billing but not yet reported.

anyOf.description: Timestamp when metered usage was last reported, when available.

lastUsageReportAt.description: Timestamp when metered usage was last reported, when available.

actions.name: humanize_text
actions.description: Humanize existing text with StealthGPT and return usage details.

text.description: Source text to humanize without instruction wrappers, up to 3,000 words.

model.description: StealthGPT model used to process the text.

qualityMode.description: Whether StealthGPT prioritizes rewrite quality or speed.

isMultilingual.description: Whether non-English source text should remain in its original language.

outputFormat.description: Format of the generated or humanized result.

inputSchema.description: Input for humanizing existing text with StealthGPT.

howLikelyToBeDetected.description: Historical StealthGPT score where a higher value means the content reads as more human.

remainingCredits.description: Prepaid word balance remaining after this request.

billingMode.description: Billing source used for this request.

meteredChargedCredits.description: Words added to metered usage, or zero when prepaid words were used.

outputSchema.description: Text processing result and billing details returned by StealthGPT.
